prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: One full-fidelity mobile product UI concept image for a design decision card, portrait 1024x1536 or similar aspect. Full-bleed flat app screenshot, no device frame, no surrounding scene, no browser chrome.
Primary request: Design the FAMILIAR ROSTER WORKSPACE concept for Pino, a youth sports club tryout evaluation and team placement application. This is an excellent familiar club-management app intended for a coach holding a phone at a soccer tryout, with clear structure, readable typography, comfortable touch targets, and clean workhorse polish.
Visual system: White #FFFFFF, deep slate #172231, and blue #2861BD. Flat pale neutral surfaces, simple dividing rules, restrained corner radii, high contrast, familiar clean sans serif typography. No photographic imagery needed, no decorative gradients or marketing treatments.
Screen composition: Selected-player detail screen with compact roster context. At top, compact Pino product header with menu icon, and visible "Sample data" label. Club context "Northside FC" and "Spring 2027 tryout". Underneath, a compact two-count strip reading "48 players" and "19 awaiting decision", followed by the blue back link "All players". Main player heading "Avery Morgan", secondary label "Graduation 2031", and a clear textual pale neutral status "Awaiting decision". Present a straightforward horizontal divider, then "Shared notes" section heading and an "Add note" button. Display two generously spaced readable note entries with small simple initial avatar marks, author labels, and the exact notes: Coach Sam — "Checks shoulder before receiving; confident turning into space." Coach Lee — "Looked comfortable with either foot in the small-sided game." Near bottom, a separated decision area with heading "Team placement", short supporting line "No decision recorded", and wide prominent blue "Record decision" button. Small secondary line "Decisions can be revised." Keep natural white space, prioritize mobile realism rather than cramming. Header, notes, and actions all comfortably visible.
Constraints: All sample facts are fictional. "Sample data" must be clearly visible. Shared notes only, no private notes. No scores, no player rankings, no approval steps, no offline controls, no invented capacity limits or team rankings. A player can have one current team per season. Allowed outcome vocabulary if needed is "Placed", "Withdrawn", "Not selected", with "Awaiting decision" for unresolved players, but this screen is explicitly the selected player awaiting decision. Do not invent additional product promises. Avoid tiny text, decorative giant labels, cards within cards, excessive whitespace that hides critical actions, and device frames. Render the text accurately and make the screenshot look like a credible polished production app.
